# Backups (cms-admin)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`backups`](../../flows/backups/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Lists the encrypted nightly dumps with size and age, warns when the newest daily dump is stale, and downloads one after re-authentication ([backups flow](../../flows/backups/FLOW.md)).

## Techniques

A view (page) folder registered in `views/Views.registry.ts`; it reads data only through feature facades ([cms-admin rules](../../apps/cms-admin/RULES.md)). The list loads only when the owner presses the button (the server throttles it). The download dialog sends the browser to the one-minute link held in a local variable only; without 2FA it points to the security settings instead.

## Technologies

React, `@abyss/form-commons`.

## Entry points

Route `/backups`, page `BackupsPage`.

## Where to change what

Size and time formats: helpers at the top of `BackupsPage.tsx`. The calls: `features/backups`.
